ruleDescriptions.INVALID_STRUCTURE: The raw output is not exactly one JSON object with the seven required fields, schema version 2, non-empty summary/explanation strings, and string arrays.
ruleDescriptions.EXTRA_PROSE: A complete JSON value can be recovered but non-whitespace text remains before or after it.
ruleDescriptions.TRUNCATED_OUTPUT: The output starts as JSON but ends with an open object, array, or string, or after a comma/colon.
ruleDescriptions.UNKNOWN_EVIDENCE_ID: At least one actual evidence ID is absent from the locked request facts.
ruleDescriptions.UNKNOWN_CAUSE_ID: At least one actual cause ID is absent from the locked cause candidates.
ruleDescriptions.UNKNOWN_CHECK_ID: At least one actual check ID is absent from the locked check candidates.
ruleDescriptions.MISSING_CAUSE: The locked expected cause set contains IDs absent from the actual cause set.
ruleDescriptions.MISSING_CHECK: The locked expected check set contains IDs absent from the actual check set.
ruleDescriptions.EXTRA_CAUSE: The actual cause set contains IDs absent from the locked expected cause set.
ruleDescriptions.EXTRA_CHECK: The actual check set contains IDs absent from the locked expected check set.
ruleDescriptions.WRONG_CAUSE: Actual and expected cause IDs differ in both directions.
ruleDescriptions.WRONG_CHECK: Actual and expected check IDs differ in both directions.
ruleDescriptions.OVER_ABSTENTION: A diagnose case has an empty cause/check selection and declares evidence insufficient.
ruleDescriptions.UNDER_ABSTENTION: A restraint case selects at least one cause or check.
ruleDescriptions.GENERIC_FALLBACK: The output selects a supplied candidate whose ID explicitly identifies it as a fallback.
ruleDescriptions.UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM: The authoritative scorer reports an unsupported claim, or a selected known candidate has no intersection with the actual known evidence IDs.
ruleDescriptions.CANDIDATE_ORDER_BIAS: Reserved for order-correlated errors supported by matched candidate permutations; no label is assigned without such a control.
ruleDescriptions.PROMPT_TEMPLATE_FAILURE: For the same base-model case, one prompt condition has diagnostic failures while the other has none.
ruleDescriptions.EOS_OR_STOP_FAILURE: The output is structurally truncated, or stops at a proper prefix of the required field sequence.
ruleDescriptions.VALIDATOR_FALSE_POSITIVE: The authoritative validator accepts an output rejected by independent structural/reference rules.
ruleDescriptions.VALIDATOR_FALSE_NEGATIVE: Reserved for a manually confirmed valid output rejected by the authoritative validator; no label is assigned from partial rule replay alone.

limitations: No specific cause or check IDs selected due to lack of evidence.
